tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtse thab pa rnams nas bya dgos kyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so// swasti/ 'dir nged rang sogs zhal ngo rim can gyi rtse thab pa rnams nas las ka 'chug med dgos kyi kha tar/ ja dpon gcig dang / tib 'khyer ba dang chu ma re mos bcas mi gsum gyis 'gan blang byed rgyu la/ gtso bo chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / lhag bsam rnam dag gi dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel zhing / rang la tshe 'dir mgo yod kyis 'jur thag tsha drag can dang gzhan gyi mi kha mi 'byung ba dang / phyi ma ngan song sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i do dam rang sems dpang por bzhag pa'i rang gis rang gcun thub pa zhig rang gal che bas/ de ltar go cha byas ngos/ las kha'i rim par/ thog mar g.yos kyi gzhi rten chu shin tu gtsang ba nas len snod kyang gtsang zhing dri nog med par kha phur dang bcas pa len skabs snod rnams thab khang de nas nyag bskyang gi khal mar bkal ngos chu len skabs kyang gtsang sbra dod pa dang / slebs bstun yang de 'phral nang du bsdus pa ma gtogs/ phyir cung zad kyang ma lus pa gal che zhing / nang gi ja thug sogs bkol snod thams cad kyang gtsang sbra can la bza' btung gi rigs gang sbyor kyang rus thon/ gnas skabs su rang rang gi ro zhim zhing / rang gzhan dang ba 'dren pa dang / phung khams skye mched kyi nad sogs tsha grang gi rigs gang la'ang mi phog cing / lus kyi zo mdog bskyed pa dang / mthar thug g.yos mkhan dang longs spyod po gnyis ka'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas bsam gtan gyi zas thob pa'i lag len 'gan gtsang kho na byed/ nged rang gi rim gro nyung ngu rnams kyi bsnyen bkur dang / de dag gi gnas skabs su rdzas dang yo byad rnams la brnab sems/ gnod sems/ ma byin len la sogs pa nyes pa thams cad spangs nas/ yang dag pa'i mtshams sbyor mthun rkyen yod pa zhig khyed tshang mas gal che/

thab nang 'dir las byed rnams dang / gsol gzim mchod 'gag yum dang bdag mo'i g.yog rkang ma rtse gad pa/ de dag thams cad las kyang gong du gyur pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan gtan nas mi gtong / za ma 'gro khungs kyang nged rang dang / gdung rgyud/ de'i gzhi rten lcam rjes 'brel tsam du/ lcam chung yum dang lhan rgyas gnas pa rnams dang / nged rang gi dmigs bsal bkod pa/ byung ba rnams ma gtogs gzhan la 'grim mi dgos pa zhig byung na 'god gtsang bas de ltar byed rgyur/ ja dpon gyis las kyi gzhi bzung / tib 'khyer ba dang chu ma gnyis re mos bgyis ngos/ de 'phros ja dpon gyi g.yog gang dgos byed rgyur mi gsum ka nas gnas skabs kun tu grwa chas sha stag dang / shing ni shing dpon gyis do len sngar bzhin byed rgyu yin pas yig don 'di la da nas bzung / ji srid gdan sa 'di 'jugs kyi bar gnas pa gal che// //zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rtse thab pa rnams nas bya dgos kyi rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
